Future<void> outer_break(
  pages,
  rows,
  save,
  load,
  cursor,
  nextCursor,
  last,
) async {
  for (final page in pages) {
    await load();
    for (final row in rows) {
      // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
      await save(row);
    }
    if (last) break;
  }
}

Future<void> outer_return(
  pages,
  rows,
  save,
  load,
  cursor,
  nextCursor,
  last,
) async {
  for (final page in pages) {
    await load();
    for (final row in rows) {
      // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
      await save(row);
    }
    if (last) return;
  }
}

Future<void> outer_sleep(
  pages,
  rows,
  save,
  load,
  cursor,
  nextCursor,
  last,
) async {
  for (final page in pages) {
    await load();
    for (final row in rows) {
      // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
      await save(row);
    }
    await Future.delayed(Duration(seconds: 1));
  }
}

Future<void> outer_condition(
  pages,
  rows,
  save,
  load,
  cursor,
  nextCursor,
  last,
) async {
  while (cursor != null) {
    await load();
    for (final row in rows) {
      // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
      await save(row);
    }
    cursor = nextCursor;
  }
}

Future<void> outer_true(
  pages,
  rows,
  save,
  load,
  cursor,
  nextCursor,
  last,
) async {
  while (true) {
    await load();
    for (final row in rows) {
      // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
      await save(row);
    }
  }
}

Future<void> outer_stream(
  pages,
  rows,
  save,
  load,
  cursor,
  nextCursor,
  last,
) async {
  await for (final page in pages) {
    await load();
    for (final row in rows) {
      // ruleid: await-in-loop-dart
      await save(row);
    }
  }
}
